_comment: Overlay on packages/maker/config/default.json for the Cloudflare Worker. Caps mirror the Mac's go-live config/local.json (maker 3.0 MON/day in total), but the roll now has its own meter (rollCapMon) so quoting can never starve the next day's roll (the 2026-10-08 incident): maker quoting 2.2 + roll 0.8. Measured roll costs at 102 gwei: maker ~0.48 + opening quotes ~0.3, operator createLadder 0.12 + 4-5 x setCanonical 0.014, market creator 4-5 x deployProxy 0.15. Vars in wrangler.toml (STATIONS, RPC_URL) and CONFIG_OVERRIDES override this file.
